001package org.clafer.compiler;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.Solution;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.Solver;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
006
007/**
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public abstract class AbstractImprovementOptimizer implements ClaferOptimizer {
012
013    protected final Solver solver;
014    protected final ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap;
015    protected final boolean[] maximizes;
016    protected final IntVar[] scores;
017
018    public AbstractImprovementOptimizer(Solver solver, ClaferSolutionMap solutionMap, boolean[] maximizes, IntVar[] scores) {
019        this.solver = solver;
020        this.solutionMap = solutionMap;
021        this.maximizes = maximizes;
022        this.scores = scores;
023    }
024
025    @Override
026    public Solver getInternalSolver() {
027        return solver;
028    }
029
030    public ClaferSolutionMap getSolutionMap() {
031        return solutionMap;
032    }
033
034    public boolean[] getMaximizes() {
035        return maximizes;
036    }
037
038    public IntVar[] getScores() {
039        return scores;
040    }
041
042    public abstract Solution solution();
043}
